name: LTCodes
summary: Validate Lithuanian personal codes, company codes, VAT numbers and IBANs.
description:
LTCodes checks Lithuanian personal codes (asmens kodas, including the birth date),
company codes, VAT numbers (PVM mokėtojo kodas) and IBANs. No dependencies; the same
rules and shared test vectors as the Rust, JavaScript and C versions of ltcodes.
